<a id="symbol-Decimal"></a>
## `Decimal` · immutable record · [source](decimals.aug#L9)

Exact decimal data: coefficient times 10 to the negative scale. It takes `coefficient` as an integer, kept read-only (Signed int64 digits; no floating-point conversion occurs) and `scale` as an integer, kept read-only (Fractional digits from 0 to 18. Scale remains part of record equality). Construction can fail with `ConversionError`.

<a id="symbol-Decimal.initialize"></a>
### `Decimal.initialize` · [source](decimals.aug#L9)

It checks that `scale` is at least `0` and `scale` is at most `18`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. [source](decimals.aug#L11-L12)

<a id="symbol-parseDecimal"></a>
## `parseDecimal` · [source](decimals.aug#L18)

Parse up to 64 ASCII characters: optional minus, integer digits, and an optional dot with 1 to 18 fractional digits.
Leading zeroes are accepted. Plus, whitespace, exponent notation and non-ASCII digits are rejected.

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Invalid text, scale, or int64 coefficient. Negative zero loses its sign).

It checks that the byte length of `text` does not equal `0` and the byte length of `text` is at most `64`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `parts` to `text.split` with `separator` `"."`. [source](decimals.aug#L19-L21)

It checks that the number of elements in `parts` is at most `2`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `scale` to `0`. If the number of elements in `parts` equals `2`, it sets `whole` to the item at index `0` in `parts`. [source](decimals.aug#L22-L33)

It sets `fraction` to the item at index `1` in `parts`. It checks that `whole` does not equal `""` and `whole` does not equal `"-"` and `fraction.isDecimal` returns true and the byte length of `fraction` is at most `18`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `scale` to the byte length of `fraction`. [source](decimals.aug#L28-L31)

If this work raises `IndexError`, it raises a `ConversionError`. It sets `coefficient` to `parseInteger` on `parts.join` with `separator` `""`. It returns a [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) with `coefficient` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L33-L35)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
parseDecimal(string text) returns Decimal unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Invalid text, scale, or int64 coefficient. Negative zero loses its sign).

</details>

<a id="symbol-formatDecimal"></a>
## `formatDecimal` · [source](decimals.aug#L38)

Format invariant ASCII text with the recorded scale, including trailing fractional zeroes. It takes `value` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal).

It sets `remaining` to `value.coefficient`. It sets `written` to `0`. It sets `result` to `""`. While `remaining` does not equal `0` or `written` is at most `value.scale`, if `written` equals `value.scale` and `value.scale` is positive, it builds `result` as the text `.{result}`. [source](decimals.aug#L39-L50)

It sets `digit` to `remaining` remainder after division by `10`. If `digit` is negative, it sets `digit` to the negative of (`digit`). It builds `result` as the text `{the text {digit}}{result}`. It sets `remaining` to `remaining` divided by `10`. [source](decimals.aug#L45-L49)

It increases `written` by `1`. After the loop, if `value.coefficient` is negative, it builds `result` as the text `-{result}`. It returns `result`. [source](decimals.aug#L50-L53)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
formatDecimal(Decimal value) returns string
```

It takes `value` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal).

</details>

<a id="symbol-rescaleDecimal"></a>
## `rescaleDecimal` · [source](decimals.aug#L59)

Change fractional scale exactly, adding or removing trailing zeroes without rounding. It takes `value` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) and `scale` as an integer. Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (Precision would be discarded or an intermediate coefficient would overflow) and `ConversionError` (Invalid target scale).

It checks that `scale` is at least `0` and `scale` is at most `18`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `coefficient` to `value.coefficient`. It sets `current` to `value.scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L60-L63)

While `current` is less than `scale`, it sets `coefficient` to [`checkedMultiply`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply) with `left` from `coefficient` and `right` `10`; then it increases `current` by `1`. After the loop, while `current` is greater than `scale`, it checks that (`coefficient` remainder after division by `10`) equals `0`. It raises an `ArithmeticError` at the first failed check. It sets `coefficient` to `coefficient` divided by `10`. [source](decimals.aug#L64-L71)

It decreases `current` by `1`. After the loop, it returns a [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) with `coefficient` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L71-L72)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
rescaleDecimal(Decimal value, int scale) returns Decimal unless ArithmeticError and ConversionError
```

It takes `value` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) and `scale` as an integer. Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (Precision would be discarded or an intermediate coefficient would overflow) and `ConversionError` (Invalid target scale).

</details>

<a id="symbol-addDecimals"></a>
## `addDecimals` · [source](decimals.aug#L75)

Add at the greater operand scale. Alignment and the sum must each fit int64. It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` and `ConversionError`.

It sets `scale` to `left.scale`. If `scale` is less than `right.scale`, it sets `scale` to `right.scale`. It sets `alignedLeft` to [`rescaleDecimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-rescaleDecimal) with `value` from `left` and `scale`. It sets `alignedRight` to [`rescaleDecimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-rescaleDecimal) with `value` from `right` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L76-L80)

It returns a [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) with `coefficient` from [`checkedAdd`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedAdd) with `left` from `alignedLeft.coefficient` and `right` from `alignedRight.coefficient` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L81)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
addDecimals(Decimal left, Decimal right) returns Decimal unless ArithmeticError and ConversionError
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` and `ConversionError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-subtractDecimals"></a>
## `subtractDecimals` · [source](decimals.aug#L84)

Subtract at the greater operand scale. Alignment and the difference must each fit int64. It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` and `ConversionError`.

It sets `scale` to `left.scale`. If `scale` is less than `right.scale`, it sets `scale` to `right.scale`. It sets `alignedLeft` to [`rescaleDecimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-rescaleDecimal) with `value` from `left` and `scale`. It sets `alignedRight` to [`rescaleDecimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-rescaleDecimal) with `value` from `right` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L85-L89)

It returns a [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) with `coefficient` from [`checkedSubtract`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedSubtract) with `left` from `alignedLeft.coefficient` and `right` from `alignedRight.coefficient` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L90)


It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` and `ConversionError`.

<a id="symbol-multiplyDecimals"></a>
## `multiplyDecimals` · [source](decimals.aug#L93)

Multiply coefficients and add scales. Reject a scale above 18 or an int64 product overflow. It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` and `ConversionError`.

It returns a [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) with `coefficient` from [`checkedMultiply`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply) with `left` from `left.coefficient` and `right` from `right.coefficient` and `scale` from `left.scale` plus `right.scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L94)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
multiplyDecimals(Decimal left, Decimal right) returns Decimal unless ArithmeticError and ConversionError
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` and `ConversionError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-divideDecimals"></a>
## `divideDecimals` · [source](decimals.aug#L100)

Divide at an explicit scale, requiring an exact result. No rounding mode is chosen implicitly. It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) and `scale` as an integer. Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (Zero divisor, inexact result, or an intermediate int64 overflow) and `ConversionError` (Target scale is outside 0 to 18).

It checks that `scale` is at least `0` and `scale` is at most `18`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It checks that `right.coefficient` does not equal `0`. It raises an `ArithmeticError` at the first failed check. [source](decimals.aug#L101-L104)

It sets `numerator` to `left.coefficient`. It sets `denominator` to `right.coefficient`. It sets `adjustment` to (`right.scale` minus `left.scale`) plus `scale`. While `adjustment` is positive, it sets `numerator` to [`checkedMultiply`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply) with `left` from `numerator` and `right` `10`; then it decreases `adjustment` by `1`. [source](decimals.aug#L105-L110)

After the loop, while `adjustment` is negative, it sets `denominator` to [`checkedMultiply`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply) with `left` from `denominator` and `right` `10`; then it increases `adjustment` by `1`. After the loop, it checks that (`numerator` remainder after division by `denominator`) equals `0`. It raises an `ArithmeticError` at the first failed check. It returns a [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) with `coefficient` from [`checkedDivide`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedDivide) with `left` from `numerator` and `right` from `denominator` and `scale`. [source](decimals.aug#L111-L116)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
divideDecimals(Decimal left, Decimal right, int scale) returns Decimal unless ArithmeticError and ConversionError
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal) and `scale` as an integer. Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (Zero divisor, inexact result, or an intermediate int64 overflow) and `ConversionError` (Target scale is outside 0 to 18).

</details>

<a id="symbol-compareDecimals"></a>
## `compareDecimals` · [source](decimals.aug#L121)

Compare numeric decimal values; return -1, 0, or 1. Equal values can have different recorded scales.
Digit comparison avoids coefficient-alignment overflow. No floating-point conversion occurs.

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

If `left.coefficient` is negative and `right.coefficient` is at least `0`, it returns `-1`. If `left.coefficient` is at least `0` and `right.coefficient` is negative, it returns `1`. It sets `leftDigits` to `join` on `split` on the text `{left.coefficient}` with `separator` `"-"` with `separator` `""`. It sets `rightDigits` to `join` on `split` on the text `{right.coefficient}` with `separator` `"-"` with `separator` `""`. [source](decimals.aug#L122-L127)

It sets `leftScale` to `left.scale`. It sets `rightScale` to `right.scale`. While `leftScale` is less than `rightScale`, it builds `leftDigits` as the text `{leftDigits}0`; then it increases `leftScale` by `1`. After the loop, while `rightScale` is less than `leftScale`, it builds `rightDigits` as the text `{rightDigits}0`; then it increases `rightScale` by `1`. [source](decimals.aug#L128-L135)

After the loop, it sets `result` to `leftDigits.compareDecimal` with `other` from `rightDigits`. It returns the negative of (`result`) if `left.coefficient` is negative, or `result` otherwise. [source](decimals.aug#L136-L139)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
compareDecimals(Decimal left, Decimal right) returns int unless ConversionError
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Decimal`](decimals.aug.md#symbol-Decimal). Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

## Dependencies

It uses [`checkedAdd`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedAdd), [`checkedDivide`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedDivide), [`checkedMultiply`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply), and [`checkedSubtract`](integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedSubtract) from `integers`.

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
